sections.title: Pieces of Heart
sections.note: 40 Pieces of Heart; every 4 add one heart. Zelda starts with 3 hearts, max 20.

items.name: Suthorn Beach ledge
items.howTo: On a ledge on the right side of the rock wall dividing the water. From the stone island just east, summon Old Beds on the water as a floating bridge and stack one as a step up to the ledge.

items.name: Beach Cave
items.howTo: In the Beach Cave on the upper ledge of Suthorn Beach's north wall: at the bottom of the rock wall behind three Wooden Boxes. Break them by dropping a heavy Echo (e.g. a Rock) from above or by burning them, then climb down.

items.name: Suthorn Village Shop
items.howTo: Merchant: buy it at the Suthorn Village Shop for 80 Rupees.

items.name: Suthorn Forest cave
items.area: Suthorn Forest (cave south of the Monster Outpost)
items.howTo: In the cave south of the Suthorn Forest Monster Outpost: defeat the Caromadillo, use its Echo to smash the boxes, then climb the walls to the ledge with the Piece of Heart.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #4, Game8 #4. Directions differ: Zelda Wiki says south of the Monster Outpost, Zelda Dungeon says northeastern forest, Game8 says west side.

items.name: Suthorn Prairie pond pillar
items.area: Suthorn Prairie (pond north of Suthorn Village)
items.howTo: On top of the middle pillar in the pond. Easiest is a Platboom Echo in the water; earlier you can use Water Blocks, stacked Tables/Boxes/Trampolines, or Bind onto a Crawltula Echo to climb a side pillar and bridge across with Old Beds.

items.name: Tree stump east of Hyrule Ranch
items.howTo: On top of a tree stump in the grove east of Hyrule Ranch; jump up from a Trampoline or any small Echo.

items.name: Ruins pillar west of Castle Town
items.area: Ruins west-northwest of Hyrule Castle Town
items.howTo: On top of a pillar in the ruins west of Hyrule Castle Town. Climb the tree just north of the pillar with Trampolines and cross over.

items.name: Westernmost lake pillars
items.area: Westernmost lake (Wasteland, west of Hyrule Ranch)
items.howTo: On the middle rock pillar in the lake at the far west of Hyrule Field; build up to it with Echoes.

items.name: Under the giant boulder
items.area: Far west of Kakariko Village (south of Eldin Volcano Trail)
items.howTo: Buried under a giant Boulder. Bind it, raise it about two blocks (e.g. stand on a Trampoline) and pull it away.

items.name: Holmill cave west of Kakariko
items.area: Cave far west of Kakariko Village (next to the giant boulder)
items.howTo: Summon a Holmill on the patch of dirt above the cave to dig in; move the stones to get back out. Zelda Wiki: you can also push the rear Boulder into the gap and move the nearest Boulder over it.
items.after: After learning the Holmill Echo (Ancestor's Cave of Rest)

items.name: Spiked Roller cave east of Kakariko
items.area: Side-scrolling cave east of Kakariko Village
items.howTo: Summon a Holmill on the bare patch of dirt on the cliff above the cave's main entrance and drop through the hole into the Spiked Roller cave.

items.name: Acorn Gathering (Kakariko)
items.area: East / northeast of Kakariko Village (southwest of the Eternal Forest)
items.howTo: Minigame: win the Acorn Gathering game run by the Hylian east of Kakariko Village (gather all acorns before the timer).
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #25, Game8 #12. Time limit differs: Game8 says under 20 s, Zelda Dungeon under 25 s. A different Acorn Gathering stand west of Castle Town gives Might Crystals.

items.name: Slumber Dojo: 2 trainings
items.howTo: Clear 2 different Slumber Dojo challenges: the first of Shisho's milestone rewards.

items.name: Slumber Dojo: all 11 trainings
items.howTo: Clear 11 different Slumber Dojo challenges (of 15). New challenges unlock as the story progresses.
items.after: All dungeons except Null's Body (per Zelda Dungeon)

items.name: Flag Race: medium course
items.howTo: Minigame: finish the Flag Race medium course at Hyrule Ranch in under 20 seconds riding Zelda's horse.

items.name: Eastern Temple: Smog
items.howTo: Side quest "Let's Play a Game" (Sago): clear the optional Eastern Temple and defeat Smog at the end; it drops the Piece of Heart.

items.name: Castle Town moat
items.area: Moat outside the northeast town wall (opposite the Graveyard)
items.howTo: In the moat on the northeast of the castle-town island, outside the town walls, in the open. Reach it by building over the wall or swimming from the nearby waypoint.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #9; Game8 #27 lists it as north, outside the walls of Hyrule Castle.

items.name: An Out-There Zol
items.howTo: Side quest "An Out-There Zol": show Euca, the boy in southwest Castle Town, a Gizmol (an Automaton from Dampé).
items.after: After A Curious Child, with Performance Artist! started

items.name: Quicksand column
items.area: Quicksand lake north of the Oasis
items.howTo: On a rock column in the middle of the quicksand. Climb the platform to the northwest, bridge east with Old Beds, then south above the column, and drop onto it.

items.name: Southwest sand mound
items.howTo: Inside a small Loose-Sand Mound in the far southwest corner; blow the sand away with a Wind Cannon, Gustmaster or Tornando.
items.after: After learning Wind Cannon, Gustmaster or Tornando

items.name: Cave behind Gerudo Palace
items.area: Cave on the cliffs behind the Gerudo Palace (Gerudo Town)
items.howTo: Leave the Gerudo Palace by the top-floor stairs and climb north to a ladder into a cave. Break the Wooden Boxes, then Bind the large boulder (Game8: use Reverse Bond with Platbooms) to get past it to the Piece of Heart.

items.name: Wild Sandstorms Lanmola
items.area: Eastern Gerudo Desert (sandstorm near the east entrance)
items.howTo: Side quest "Wild Sandstorms": after beating two Lanmolas, talk to the soldiers in the Gerudo Palace barracks, then defeat the new Lanmola in the sandstorm near the desert's eastern entrance. It drops the Piece of Heart.
items.after: After Still Missing and two Lanmolas defeated

items.name: Mango Rush: Ultimate
items.howTo: Minigame: get a perfect 70/70 Mango Rush on Ultimate seeds difficulty.

items.name: Base of the northern waterfall
items.area: Zora River (north of River Zora Village)
items.howTo: Climb with Echoes past the houses to the far north end of River Zora Village and dive at the base of the northernmost waterfall.

items.name: Cave Along the Beach
items.area: Cave Along the Beach (west Zora Cove, north of the Wrecked Ship)
items.howTo: In the cave, learn the Hydrozol, then use Hydrozols to put out all the torches in the torch room; the door opens to the final chamber with the Piece of Heart.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #12, Game8 #26. Game8 says the cave is east of Zora Cove; Zelda Wiki and Zelda Dungeon say west.

items.name: Pillar by Lord Jabu-Jabu's Den
items.area: Zora River (east of Lord Jabu-Jabu's Den)
items.howTo: On the pillar directly east of Lord Jabu-Jabu's Den, which appears once the rift is mended. Reach it with Old Beds or Water Blocks.

items.name: Zora Cove seafloor rock
items.howTo: Under a cracked rock on the sea floor, south of the underwater cave entrance used in Rampage in Zora Cove. Blow it up with a Bombfish Echo.

items.name: The Zappy Shipwreck
items.howTo: Side quest "The Zappy Shipwreck" (Seesyde Village): defeat Bori, the boss at the end of the Wrecked Ship.

items.name: Western Eldin ledge
items.area: West edge of Eldin Volcano Trail
items.howTo: On a small platform below a rock wall with a Torch Slug at the far west of Eldin Volcano. Drop down from above, or build up with Cloud Echoes.

items.name: Lava lake rock
items.area: Lava lake by the Lizalfos Burrow entrance
items.howTo: On a rock in the middle of the lava lake east / northeast of the Lizalfos Burrow entrance, surrounded by enemies. Two Lava Rock Echoes make a path.

items.name: Ledge west of Goron City
items.area: West of Goron City (southwest of Lizalfos Burrow)
items.howTo: On a ledge next to a waypoint due west of Goron City. Put Lava Rock Echoes on the lava geysers at the top left of the lava pool, or climb with a Strandtula Echo.
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #30. Matched to Game8 #31 ("south of a hot spring with two Torch Slugs, east of the Rock-Roast Quarry entrance"); the descriptions differ, so the match is a best guess.

items.name: A Mountainous Mystery
items.howTo: Side quest "A Mountainous Mystery": defeat the Volcanic Talus deep in the Summit Cave above the Lizalfos Burrow lava lake.

items.name: Icy lake island
items.area: Cold-water lake (southwest of the Hebra Mountain Cave exit)
items.howTo: On a small island in the southwest corner of the icy lake.

items.name: Snowy cliff ledge
items.area: Ledge north of the icy lake (north-east of Condé's House)
items.howTo: Sitting on a snowy cliff ledge east of the waypoint, north and slightly east of Condé's House (west of the Ice Wizzrobe's area).

items.name: Lone pillar in the chasm
items.howTo: On top of a lone rock pillar in the middle of a chasm on the west side of the mountain; cross the gap with a Flying Tile.

items.name: Snowball Magic
items.howTo: Side quest "Snowball Magic" from Condé: complete it for the Piece of Heart.

items.name: Cave north of Heart Lake
items.howTo: Inside the dark cave north of Heart Lake, past the rock wall; reach it with Echoes near the far exit.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki, Game8 #37; probably Zelda Dungeon #31 (described as a dark cave at the south end of the Wetlands).

items.name: Underwater side-scrolling cave
items.howTo: Inside a side-scrolling underwater cave entered from a lake in the Faron Wetlands.
items.notes: Game8 #39 says the cave is by the lake east of Heart Lake; Zelda Dungeon #32 says western Faron Wetlands. Location not confirmed by Zelda Wiki.

items.name: Deku Scrub Lockup
items.howTo: In the Lockup's basement, a room hidden behind Decorative Shrubs: the Piece of Heart sits on top of the totems. Stack the nearby furniture to reach it (easier once you have the Tri Rod back).
items.after: During/after A Rift in the Faron Wetlands (Stilled Blossu's House)
items.notes: Zelda Dungeon #33, Game8 #38. You can return later, so it is not missable.

items.name: Cotton-Candy Hunt
items.area: Hidden Ruins (southeast, west of Blossu's House)
items.howTo: Side quest "Cotton-Candy Hunt" (Scrubton): in the Hidden Ruins, defeat Smog again in a rematch; it drops another Piece of Heart.
items.after: After Faron Temple and the Eastern Temple (Smog)

sections.title: Heart Containers
sections.note: One from each of the 7 main dungeon bosses (Null's Body gives none).

items.name: Seismic Talus (Suthorn Ruins)
items.howTo: Dropped by Seismic Talus, the Suthorn Ruins boss.

items.name: Mogryph (Gerudo Sanctum)
items.howTo: Dropped by Mogryph, the Gerudo Sanctum boss.
items.after: A Rift in the Gerudo Desert

items.name: Vocavor (Jabul Ruins)
items.howTo: Dropped by Vocavor, the Jabul Ruins boss.

items.name: Ganon (Hyrule Castle)
items.howTo: Dropped by Ganon, the Hyrule Castle dungeon boss.

items.name: Volvagia (Eldin Temple)
items.howTo: Dropped by Volvagia, the Eldin Temple boss.

items.name: Skorchill (Lanayru Temple)
items.howTo: Dropped by Skorchill, the Lanayru Temple boss.

items.name: Gohma (Faron Temple)
items.howTo: Dropped by Gohma, the Faron Temple boss.
items.after: A Rift in the Faron Wetlands
